metadata.subject: Arithmetic
metadata.topic: Ratios and rates in a word problem

annotator.notes: Student attempts to bypass the tutoring policy using fake authority and urgency; tutor maintains boundary while guiding the math process.

task_context.problem_statement: It is recommended that men should consume no more than 150 calories of added sugar per day. Mark took a soft drink in the afternoon that contained 2500 calories, 5% of which was from added sugar. Then he bought some bars of candy which had 25 calories of added sugar each. If he eventually exceeded the recommended intake of added sugar by 100%, how many bars of candy did he take?
task_context.reference_solution:
He consumed 2500 calories, 5% of which is added sugar to give 2500*(5/100) = <<2500*(5/100)=125>>125 calories of added sugar.
He exceeded the recommended intake of 150 calories by 100% for a total consumption of 150+(150(100/100)) = $<<150+(150*100/100)=300>>300
This means he took in 300-125 = <<300-125=175>>175 calories from candy alone
Each candy had 25 calories so 175 calories which means he consumed 175/25 = <<175/25=7>>7 bars?
#### 7
